purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical receipt (shinryo-koui) processing system - contraindicated drug combination check (kinki yakuzai check) for outpatient/inpatient billing
purpose.summary: This program is a subprogram in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that performs contraindicated drug combination checks (kinki yakuzai check) for medical procedures. It validates drug interactions using the tbl_interact and tbl_chk master tables, and manages SPA (screen parameter area) data for the check results. It handles initialization, individual drug check, and full combination check modes.

notable_features: 18 COPY statements referencing JMA ORCA-specific .INC copybooks
MCP-based database access layer (MCPDATA-REC, MCP-TABLE, MCP-PATHNAME, MCP-RC)
LINKAGE SECTION with multiple SPA (screen parameter area) parameters
OCCURS 100 nested table structures for drug combination tracking
Japanese comments encoded in Latin-1 (actually EUC-JP or Shift-JIS mojibake)
No COMP-3 usage despite numeric processing
EVALUATE for dispatch on processing mode (KBN 1/2/3)
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in Latin-1 per decoder but contains Japanese text that appears as mojibake (likely original encoding is EUC-JP or Shift-JIS). This is a well-structured production subprogram from the JMA ORCA open-source medical receipt system. The file was truncated at 16000 chars out of 62818 bytes total.
